title: Circuit query with appended input
statement: Let $m : \mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and for each $n\in\mathbb{N}$ let $D_n$ be a fan-in-two Boolean circuit with $n+m(n)$ input bits. Suppose $z,w$ are bit strings and $|z|=N$. Then the query asking whether $D_N$ accepts the concatenation $z\mathbin{+}w$ holds exactly when there is an assignment $y\in\{0,1\}^{m(|z|)}$ such that $w$ is the bit string of $y$ in order and $D_{|z|}$ accepts the combined input consisting of $z$ followed by $y$.
hypotheses_covered: A family $D_n$ of circuits with $n+m(n)$ input bits
